messages:
Hannah Liu: Quick ask  candidate for Data Infra lead negotiated a competing offer. Hiring manager proposing base = $215k (band max $200k), $15k sign-on (one-time), and pro-rated FY bonus. Start target 2025-07-01. Need exception, benefits start alignment, and sign-on repayment clause.

Terrence Gomez: Candidate will only join if sign-on included. We can move headcount from an open req; no net new HC. Please include market comp memo and last 3 comps.

Maya Singh: Uploading comps and proposed offer packet now: https://redwood-internal/offers/2418901234. Also attached suggested repayment clause for 12 months.

Rory Caldwell: Heads-up: >band base requires VP People + Comp Committee sign-off. One-time sign-on can be approved by Comp Chair if within retention policy limits. Also need payroll impact for bonus proration.

offer-approvals-bot: Request 2418901234 received. Routing to: Comp Committee, VP People, Finance. Priority: High. ETA 36 hours.

Terrence Gomez: Candidate wants benefits effective from first US payroll. If we set start 2025-07-01 and payroll cycles delay, they may have gap. Can we backdate benefits?

benefits-ops: Benefits Ops: We can set benefits effective date to align with payroll start if payroll creation is completed beforehand. Otherwise we can offer temporary health stipend for the gap. Need payroll confirmation and candidate SSN on file.

Maya Singh: We can collect paperwork quickly. Manager requests decision by 2025-06-25 EOD or candidate will accept counteroffer.

Rory Caldwell: Finance: provide run-rate calc and retention budget availability. If sign-on > $10k, needs CFO concurrence for retention fund draw.

Terrence Gomez: Proposed options in packet: (1) keep base at band ($200k) + $15k sign-on; (2) uplift base to $215k and reduce sign-on to $5k. Candidate prefers option 2 for comp mix.

tax-bot: Tax advisory note: shifting comp mix (higher base) affects headcount run-rate and may change future equity levelling implications. One-time sign-on may be taxable in full upon payment. If repaying sign-on clause exists, ensure repayment language covers tax gross-up responsibilities.

Rory Caldwell: Comp Committee preliminary: Option 1 preferred (keep recurring within band, use one-time retention). Option 2 increases recurring run-rate and requires VP + CFO sign-off.

offer-approvals-bot: Update: Comp Committee scheduled review in 12 hours. Marked as expedited.

Hannah Liu: If committee approves Option 1 today we can confirm by 2025-06-25 and lock start 2025-07-01 with benefits coordination. Please prioritize the retention fund approval.

Terrence Gomez: Noted  candidate notified we expect final within 24-36 hours. Thanks everyone. :pray:
